target.title: fix: chat.send no reply when thinking metadata is set
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users sending a normal `chat.send` message with per-message thinking metadata could see the user turn persist but receive no assistant response. The gateway converted structured `thinking` metadata into textual `/think ...` command input, so clients without text slash-command authority could have the turn gated as a command before model dispatch.

No related open GitHub issue or PR was found. I searched live GitHub and local gitcrawl for:

- `chat.send thinking`
- `Android chat no reply`
- `chat finished without visible assistant reply`
- `CommandBody /think`
- `phone chat no assistant response`
- `paired device slash command unauthorized`

The only direct live keyword hit was the already-merged #79385, which is a broader thinking/fast controls PR rather than this no-reply bug report.

## Why This Change Was Made

`chat.send` already passes per-message thinking through `replyOptions.thinkingLevelOverride`, which is the structured dispatch path. This change removes the duplicate `/think <level> <message>` rewrite for normal messages, leaving `CommandBody`, `BodyForCommands`, and `CommandTurn.body` as the parsed user message.

This intentionally does not add a generic "no visible assistant reply" guard. The proven root cause is the duplicate command-text rewrite, and the narrow fix keeps the command-routing contract unchanged for real slash-prefixed messages.

## User Impact

Mobile, WebChat, and other `chat.send` clients can set a one-shot thinking level without accidentally turning a normal user message into a text slash command. Normal messages with `thinking: "low"` now proceed to agent dispatch as normal user turns while still applying the requested thinking override.

## Evidence

Behavioral proof:

- Added a regression case for `chat.send` with `message: "hello from phone"` and `thinking: "low"`.
- Before the production fix, the regression failed because `BodyForCommands` was rewritten to `/think low <message>`.
- After the fix, the regression proves:
  - `BodyForCommands === "hello from phone"`
  - `CommandBody === "hello from phone"`
  - `CommandTurn.kind === "normal"`
  - `replyOptions.thinkingLevelOverride === "low"`

Validation:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/chat.directive-tags.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` - passed on the rebased branch, 264 tests.
- `pnpm build` - passed on the rebased branch.
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD` - passed.
- `rg -n "TEMP mobile-chat|probe_fixed_chat_send" src dist apps packages extensions 2>/dev/null || true` - no matches.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local ...` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

AI-assisted: yes. A sanitized transcript was not included because adding transcript logs requires explicit approval.
